data.title: W · 浅滩爆破狂想曲
data.action: 大大咧咧地坐在锈迹斑斑的浮标上，一手将水枪像榴弹发射器一样扛在肩上，白发红眸，露出标志性嘲弄而疯癫的咧嘴大笑，萨卡兹恶魔角在烈日下闪闪发亮
data.location: 散落着生锈水雷外壳与废弃浮标的荒凉浅滩
data.lighting: 刺目正午强光，高对比度色彩与金属锈迹质感
data.mood: 狂气疯批、恶作剧坏笑、佣兵式肆意妄为
data.description: 退潮浅滩废弃金属浮标周围。W身穿狂热佣兵红黑涂鸦防晒拉链潜水短衣，毫无淑女包袱地骑坐在浮标顶端。她将改装水枪重重扛在肩上，赤红的双眼弯成狡黠的弧度，咧开嘴露出标志性的恶作剧狂笑，准备随时用带着薄荷冲击的水炮将你淋个透心凉。
data.promptProse: W perches recklessly atop a massive rusted sea buoy in sun-drenched shallows, wearing a carbon-black cropped zip-up rashguard splashed with crimson graffiti and worn partially unzipped over red tie-side micro bikini bottoms. Shouldering an oversized pressurized water cannon with a wicked, razor-sharp grin, she leans toward the camera amid blazing midday sun and flying water spray.
data.animaCaption: Perched astride a rusted naval buoy in shallow surf in a partly unzipped black-and-crimson graffiti cropped rashguard and red micro bikini bottoms, she hoists a bulky water cannon onto one shoulder and flashes a reckless grin. Blazing midday sunlight explodes across flying sea spray.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a carbon-black cropped zip-up rashguard sprayed with crimson graffiti, worn partly unzipped over red tie-side micro bikini bottoms.
